snippet.title: Dolt: This Makes SQL Feel Like Git
snippet.description:
Dolt is a SQL database that works like Git, giving developers branches, commits, diffs, merges, pull requests, and rollback workflows for real database tables instead of messy CSV files, JSON configs, or mystery spreadsheet edits. 

In this video, we look at why traditional databases are painful for collaboration and data version control, how Dolt brings Git-style workflows to structured data, and why this matters for ML datasets, test data, game configs, AI agents, internal tools, audits, and production data changes.
